premise: Xander is a teenage boy who is also a zombie. Becoming undead did not cancel school, family, chores, friends, embarrassment, pizza, or teenage problems.
rules: Xander is a person first and a zombie second.
Being undead complicates ordinary teenage life instead of replacing it.
Keep gore mild unless an approved story specifically calls for more.
Do not silently contradict an approved episode.
Cross-realm events can leak into Xander's story, but Xander does not initially understand the larger system.
User-supplied memes are context/inspiration; generated pages should be original rather than copies of third-party artwork.
established: Xander woke up dead on a Tuesday.
Being dead does not excuse chores.
An impossible wooded path exists near town.
The path can connect to the moss/Morri realm.
A chess-knight artifact can leak into the comic from Morri.
recurring_jokes: ordinary consequences matter during supernatural emergencies
Xander often worries about normal teenage problems first
open_threads: why objects from other realms enter the comic
how normal life reacts to Xander being undead
